summary: Standing tower beside a Georgia Forestry Commission office in McDuffie County, Georgia; NHLR-registered 2015. Build date, staffing, fires and access not found in sources.

facts.design: 82-foot Aermotor LS-40 galvanized tower with 7 by 7 by 10 foot steel cab (register says it appears to be)

events.note: Registered June 9, 2015 as US 1069, GA 18; nominated by Michael T. Finch, Jr.

evidence.supports: administered by the Georgia Forestry Commission
register describes an 82-foot Aermotor LS-40 galvanized tower, hedged with 'appears'
evidence.quote: This lookout appears to be an 82-foot Aermotor LS-40 galvanized tower with a 7'x7'x10' steel cab.

evidence.supports: two radio antennas; may be a repeater station
evidence.quote: Two radio antennas are visible, suggesting it may be used as a repeater station.

evidence.supports: located next to an active Georgia Forestry Commission office
evidence.quote: It is located next to an active Georgia Forestry Commission office.

evidence.supports: nominated by Michael T. Finch, Jr.
Georgia list gives elevation 512 ft for McDuffie

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 519 ft (158 m); the Georgia list gives 512 ft. The story reports both; the record keeps the NHLR figure, which matches the brief.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: NHLR detail page is the only substantive source; the Georgia list is a bare table. Brief record checked: registration, registry numbers, elevation and agency match. No build date, staffing, fire or access sources found after two web searches. A 2017 blog post titled 'Old Fire Watch Tower in Thomson' (forgottengeorgia2.blogspot.com) mentions a watch tower in Thomson but gives no location or date, so it is not linked to this tower. A 2019 McDuffie County wildfire plan (gatrees.org/resources/mcduffie-cwpp-2019/) mentions a GFC unit in the county; only grepped, not cited. Access level left unset.
